"""TaskDesk: SQLite data access layer (stdlib sqlite3)."""
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "taskdesk.db"


def connect(path=None):
    p = Path(path) if path else DB_PATH
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(p))
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def init_db(path=None):
    conn = connect(path)
    conn.executescript(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        );
        """
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


VALID_STATUSES = ("todo", "in_progress", "done")


def create_task(title, description="", status="todo", path=None):
    if not title or not str(title).strip():
        raise ValueError("title is required")
    if status not in VALID_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError(f"status must be one of {VALID_STATUSES}")
    conn = connect(path)
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (str(title).strip(), description or "", status),
    )
    conn.commit()

"""API tests for TaskDesk using Flask test client."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from taskdesk import create_app
import pytest


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path):
    app = create_app(db_path=str(tmp_path / "test.db"))
    app.testing = True
    return app.test_client()


def test_health(client):
    r = client.get("/api/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.get_json()["ok"] is True


def test_create_and_list(client):
    r = client.post("/api/tasks", json={"title": "Learn Flask", "description": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    t = r.get_json()["task"]
    assert t["title"] == "Learn Flask"
    assert t["status"] == "todo"
    r2 = client.get("/api/tasks")
    titles = [x["title"] for x in r2.get_json()["tasks"]]
    assert "Learn Flask" in titles


def test_create_requires_title(client):
    r = client.post("/api/tasks", json={"title": "   "})
    assert r.status_code == 400


def test_invalid_status(client):
    r = client.post("/api/tasks", json={"title": "x", "status": "nope"})
    assert r.status_code == 400


def test_search_case_insensitive(client):
    client.post("/api/tasks", json={"title": "Fix Bug Alpha"})
    client.post("/api/tasks", json={"title": "unrelated task"})
    r = client.get("/api/tasks?q=fix bug")
    tasks = r.get_json()["tasks"]
    assert len(tasks) == 1
    assert tasks[0]["title"] == "Fix Bug Alpha"

# TaskDesk

Локальное веб-приложение для управления задачами.

## Возможности
- Локальная база данных **SQLite** (файл `taskdesk/taskdesk.db`)
- Создание задач
- Список задач
- Поиск без учёта регистра (по названию и описанию)
- Изменение статуса задачи (`todo`, `in_progress`, `done`)
- Веб-интерфейс (Flask + vanilla JS)
- REST API (Flask)
- Автоматические тесты (pytest)

## Архитектура
- `taskdesk/db.py` — слой доступа к SQLite (stdlib `sqlite3`)
- `taskdesk/app.py` — Flask-приложение: API + шаблон UI
- `taskdesk/templates/index.html` — интерфейс
- `taskdesk/tests/test_api.py` — тесты через `app.test_client()`

## Запуск
```bash
python run.py            # http://127.0.0.1:5000
# или
python -m taskdesk       # то же самое
```
Порт можно задать переменной окружения `TASKDESK_PORT`.

## API
| Метод | Путь | Описание |
|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/health | проверка живости |
| GET | /api/tasks?q=...&status=... | список/поиск |
| POST | /api/tasks | создать `{"title","description"}` |
| GET | /api/tasks/<id> | одна задача |
| PATCH | /api/tasks/<id> | `{"status":"todo\|in_progress\|done"}` |
| DELETE | /api/tasks/<id> | удалить |

## Тесты
```bash
python -m pytest -q
```
